programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: The West Texas desert has a way of pulling you in. In Desert Ghost, Will Cooper heads west to Marathon, Texas, with longtime friend and mentor Cody Roberts to hunt aoudad in one of the most remote landscapes in the state. Rooted in family legacy, this film explores Cody’s deep ties to the desert, the story behind Desert Ghost Distillery, and the mystique of a western oasis near Big Bend National Park. More than a hunt, Desert Ghost dives into the role of aoudad management and its importance to desert bighorn sheep conservation efforts led by Texas Parks and Wildlife and the Wild Sheep Foundation. Sometimes, to protect what belongs here — you have to chase the ghosts. You really do have to be tough, determined, or one lucky bastard to make it out in West Texas.

programme.title: Bake With Anna Olson

programme.title: The Chocolate Queen
programme.desc: Savour the flavours of France in this indulgent episode! Kirsten bakes golden honey madeleines, a rich and comforting date pudding, and a creamy, irresistible ice cream. To top it off, she answers a common baking dilemma: how to rescue split cream or ganache.

programme.title: Jamie's 15 Minute Meals
programme.sub-title: Quick Lamb Tagine, Pan-Fried Aubergine and Cumin Crunch / Crispy Polenta Chicken Caesar Salad
programme.desc: Chef Jamie Oliver makes a quick lamb tagine with pan-fried eggplant and cumin crunch, plus a crispy chicken Caesar salad.

programme.title: Feast By Fire
programme.desc: Jess heads to Mum Foods Smokehouse & Delicatessen to explore the craft behind exceptional pastrami. Inspired, she walks viewers through her own achievable take at home, simplifying the curing and smoking process while still delivering that signature deli-style flavour.

programme.title: Chuck And The First Peoples Kitchen
programme.desc: Chuck visits Winnipeg, the largest urban Indigenous population in Canada and learns about Metis cuisine. In this city of contrasts, Chuck meets with passionate indigenous residents who help make this food desert a better place with the help of a community oven.

programme.title: Wall of Bakers
programme.desc: The home bakers start out with the desserts that made them famous in their own worlds, and Chef Christine Cushing churns things up with the apple butter in her pantry.

programme.title: The Chocolate Queen
programme.desc: Kirsten wows us with her scrumptious chocolate pecan pie, irresistible raspberry coconut chocolate slices, some creative and delicious meringue lollipops and the best brownie you will ever make.

programme.title: Jamie's 15 Minute Meals
programme.sub-title: Glazed Sizzling Chops, Sweet Tomato and Asparagus Lasagnetti / Mushroom Soup, Stilton, Apple and Walnut Croutes
programme.desc: Chef Jamie Oliver cooks glazed sizzling chops, sweet tomato and asparagus lasagnetti, plus mushroom soup, stilton, and apple and walnut crostini.

programme.title: Wall of Chefs
programme.desc: In a high stakes Chef’s Fridge round, Chef Lynn Crawford challenges the home cooks to create a delectable dish using maple syrup, collard greens, parmesan cheese, and turkey!

programme.title: Hot Mess Express
programme.sub-title: Hot Mess Noel meets Chef Deanna
programme.desc: Our hot mess Noel comes from a family of cooks, but has mostly ordered in so far. Will Chef Deanna manage to help her remember all those kitchen skills and make a restaurant level Chicken Dumplings?

programme.title: Hot Mess Express
programme.sub-title: Hot Mess Monty and Chef Lauren
programme.desc: Monty, our Hot Mess, wants to impress his girlfriend by cooking Bulgogi Beef from scratch. With Chef Lauren by his side – will be make it in time? How will his dish compare to the restaurant’s?

programme.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt

programme.desc: In this action-packed adventure, we push deep into the remote forests west of Timmins with an incredible young angler, Cohen. Join us as Cohen showcases the spirit of Northern adventure and the rewards of getting off the beaten path.

programme.title: FishON! | Storm’s Edge Success: Fishing Frederick House Lake

It's all about adapting to the elements and making the most of the moment!

programme.desc: Charlotte’s taking her chance in the big city. programme.desc: Brielle has always believed the ocean floor is full of treasures just waiting to be found. Over the years she has dived to find coins, lost jewelry and more in the waters of Tahiti. Instead of profiting from them, she loves reuniting people with their lost valuables. When she finds a class ring and returns it to Marcus, a handsome US Navy serviceman, Brielle soon discovers what has been missing in her life – a treasure of the heart.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.sub-title: El Problema de Llamarse Gustavo Petró
programme.desc: Gustavo Petró, periodista brasileño de tecnología en São Paulo, recibe diariamente entre 50 y 100 mensajes ofensivos en Twitter debido a la confusión con su homónimo, el político colombiano Gustavo Petro. Aunque le divierte la situación, también teme por su familia. Los Informantes reunió a ambos hombres para hablar sobre cómo es compartir nombre con alguien tan diferente y controvertido.

programme.title: Maury
programme.sub-title: He vuelto... ¡Esta vez sé quién es el padre de mi bebé!
programme.desc: Adrian revela su secreto de infidelidad: ¿es Benjamin el padre de su hijo? Heather vuelve para otra prueba de ADN con Robert. ¿Qué dirán los resultados?

programme.title: Maury
programme.sub-title: ¡Eres dos veces mayor que mi hija, infiel!
programme.desc: La furiosa mamá Patty quiere demostrar que el novio de su hija, Dale, un hombre que duplica la edad de su hija, ha sido infiel. ¿Entonces Bam fue infiel a Brianna en su propia cama?

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: La adolescente Megan vive con su antiguo novio controlador Rick. Megan no puede ir a la escuela, buscar trabajo, ni comer sin su permiso. ¿Pueden su tía y Steve lograr hacerla entender?

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.sub-title: ¿Quién le robó a mi hijo discapacitado?
programme.desc: El hijo de Kimberly nació con una rara enfermedad y ella sospecha que su padre robaba para su tratamiento. A Avonte le diagnosticaron cáncer poco común y no recibió nada de la recaudación que organizó su tía Terceira.

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Tras sobrevivir a una loca persecución en coche, perder la pierna y estar en coma a causa de su esposo, Portia finalmente lo confrontará. No admitirá la culpa, pero hoy Steve está ayudando a Portia a hacerse oír.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Torrance admite haber sido infiel a su novia con un giro sorprendente. Entonces, Heather quiere que Tramisha, el ex de su novio, deje de interferir en su relación.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.sub-title: Dormí con tu gemela y tu mamá
programme.desc: Una mujer se acuesta con el novio de su hermana gemela; un hombre queda atrapado entre dos mujeres; un hombre le pide a un amigo que mienta por él.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.sub-title: El regreso de los huéspedes del pasado Parte 2
programme.desc: Jaycee le demuestra a Brandy que nunca es correcto ser infiel y arruinar a una familia. Casi cree que su prometido podría aprender una lección de Kevin, un antiguo invitado. Además, concertamos una cita entre la espectadora Tamara y el invitado Nathan.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.sub-title: Mi mamá se robó a mi novia
programme.desc: Shianne confiesa que fue infiel a Mistress Delicious con su mamá Blonde. Después, la madre del bebé de Chris se enfrenta a él por dejarla por su compañera de trío.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.sub-title: Soy gay y me acuesto con tu sobrino
programme.desc: Kenny se junta con una mujer que lo presiona para tener una relación, pero tiene una sorpresa para ella: la posesiva Kelsey confronta a su novio y a la mujer con la que se acostó en una fiesta en una casa; Jeremy quiere terminar su relación.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Paraísos naturales se vuelven escenarios de tragedia por empresas informales, guías sin capacitación y falta de control. Vidas como las de José, Liliana y Andrea se apagaron, mientras familias claman justicia y mayor regulación.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Yiset Silva y Lisandro Rodríguez enfrentan un misterio tras el parto de su hija el 31 de diciembre de 2020 en Armenia. La clínica dice que la bebé nació sin vida, pero la familia cree que está viva. Inconsistencias en la historia clínica y una necropsia sin órganos aumentan sus dudas. La Fiscalía investiga.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: A pesar de los esfuerzos para promover el turismo, hay un número creciente de ataques en Colombia.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Los padres luchan por mantener a sus hijos adolescentes y preadolescentes a salvo de los peligros de Internet.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.sub-title: En La Mente De Un Celópata
programme.desc: Jhon Ferney, condenado por feminicidio en 2015, muestra los efectos de la celopatía, trastorno originado en la infancia por la falta de afecto. Su historia revela cómo los celos enfermizos y una relación tóxica desembocaron en tragedia.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Hogares convertidos en escenarios de violencia. Historias de arrendatarios que ocultan secretos, mientras familias vulnerables enfrentan tragedias impensables. En un país donde el arriendo es necesidad, la confianza se paga con vidas y silencio.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Desde su inicio en 1996, Séptimo Día ha sido un referente del periodismo investigativo en Colombia. Historias arriesgadas, denuncias impactantes y la valentía de sus reporteros han marcado el rumbo de una televisión que no teme confrontar la verdad.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Desde los 12 años, una niña fue abusada por un pariente que luego se convirtió en su asesino. Jorge Alonso, tras evadir a la policía por 7 años y cambiar de identidad, fue capturado y espera juicio en Bucaramanga.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2013, María Isabel Delgado y su hija Selena desaparecieron en Pasto, Nariño. Tras días de búsqueda, se reveló que Milton, esposo de María Isabel y también su primo, las había asesinado para ocultar que era padre de otra bebé fruto de una relación extramarital secreta. Los cuerpos fueron hallados enterrados con señales de violencia. Milton fue declarado autor intelectual del doble homicidio y condenado a 33 años de prisión.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Jessica Mayerli Alza, una estudiante de 16 años, es hallada desmembrada dentro de una maleta en el sur de Bogotá. La investigación reveló que Andrea, su mejor amiga, la asesinó al descubrir que Jessica sostenía una relación con su esposo, Leimar. Autoridades sospechan que Andrea tuvo cómplices en el crimen. Un año después, Andrea Valdez Contreras fue condenada a 345 meses de prisión por homicidio agravado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Óscar es asesinado en su cuarto. Al principio parecía suicidio, pero su amigo Yeison fue arrestado y reveló que la ex esposa, Paola, lo mandó matar por el seguro. Yeison recibe 17 años de cárcel. Paola proclama su inocencia.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En La Virginia, Risaralda, Heidy Yuliani Restrepo, una niña de 11 años, desapareció el 31 de diciembre de 2013 y fue hallada muerta días después en un caño. La investigación señaló a su propia madre, María Preselia Martínez, como responsable del crimen, motivado presuntamente por la pérdida de una sim card. Fue condenada por homicidio agravado y cumple su condena en la cárcel de mujeres La Badea, en Pereira.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Edenis Barrera Benavides, líder social y voluntaria de la Defensa Civil, fue brutalmente asesinada en 2014.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Guadalupe está demandando a Thomas, el dueño de una tienda de vestidos de Quinceañera, por dolor y sufrimiento más el costo del vestido que es de $4,500.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Wilbur y su esposa, Lucia, están demandando a la hermana de Wilbur, Jennifer, por $200,000 después de que su hijo quedó fuera del testamento de su abuela.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Barbara demanda al club de striptease de Emilio por 30.000 dólares, alegando negligencia y angustia emocional. Ella afirma haber sufrido un latigazo cervical por la actuación de Jackson y una silla que se derrumbó. Emilio niega su responsabilidad, citando la seguridad y el consumo de alcohol de Bárbara.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Giselle está demandando a su padre, Albert Martinez, por angustia emocional y $145,000 por el costo de cancelar su boda.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Annie demanda a su ex mejor amiga Olivia por 150.000 dólares de angustia emocional. Olivia, una vez dama de honor, secuestró los planes de boda, cambiando de lugar y de vestidos. programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Edward Rincón y Weimar Castro, primos de 19 años, fueron víctimas de "falsos positivos": jóvenes inocentes asesinados por el ejército y presentados como guerrilleros caídos en combate. En 2004, desaparecieron tras salir con una amiga y fueron hallados acribillados. Sus madres, Inés y Beatriz, llevan 17 años luchando por justicia, enfrentando amenazas mientras buscan la verdad sobre lo ocurrido a sus hijos.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Tres historias: Gina Sharik Ávila, adolescente colombiana, padece el raro síndrome Kleine-Levin, "la bella durmiente", que la sume en sueños de hasta 70 días. Augusto Pinochet Molina III, nieto del dictador chileno, defiende el legado de su abuelo en medio de las protestas de 2019. Camilo Herrera, tras quebrar en 2008, fundó "Un Litro de Luz", llevando iluminación solar con botellas recicladas a comunidades de más de 23 países.

programme.desc: Después de meses de rogar y suplicar, Latoya perdonó a Justice por su infidelidad. ¡Pero ahora han vuelto para someterlo a juicio por lo mismo! programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Delta Wing Racer with a Vengance - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: State-of-the-art engineering and passion projects take center stage on this edition of Caffeine & Octane. The revolutionary Delta Wing Racer turns on hot lap after hot lap at Road Atlanta, and driver Katherine Legge offers insight on how “less is more” when it comes to power to weight ratios; the dark world of a graffiti artist paints a picture of a car called Vengeance while the hosts share the eclectic hybrids of machines that make it to Caffeine and Octane with Vengance’s creator Totem.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Henry Ford III & Counterfeit Cars - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the ultimate scene and the place to be seen. Even after 12 hours of racing at the Petit Le Mans endurance race, Henry Ford III, the great grandson of Henry Ford the industrial magnate and current member of Ford’s Board of Directors, showed up to take in the sights, address the crowds, and sign a one of a kind Ford Shelby GT350R. The GT350R will hit the road with Operation Hope to encourage young people to study math and science through motorsports; Covert car counterfeiter, Chuck Beck looks for Ford’s approval on his own version of a muscled up Festiva. YouTuber ‘That Dude in Blue’ David Patterson joins Skip and Bryan to get a special look at the motor-based philanthropic outreach and amazing cars that come with it done by John Hope Bryant, friend of Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Rickey and Bryan race outside of their comfort zones, each competing to find the raddest car collection. Rickey hangs out with classic racer, Ron Green, who shows him the ropes in the ultra light '83 Ralt RT5. Bryan visits a collection of 120 racing motorcycle owned by mechanic and racer Mike McConville. Mike takes Bryan motorcross racing in his backyard after showing off his high horsepowered car collection. Caffeine and Octane alongside Ron Green visit Atlanta's first Concours d'elegance to look at classic cars that have been perfectly maintained for decades.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - The Wrap on the Most Beautiful Cars
programme.desc: Wayne Phears’ Jaguar E-Type was nothing more than a diamond in the rough before the mineral rights attorney took on the basket case. Caffeine & Octane brings viewers the story of how Phears’, through relentless research and determination, restored and reunited the #10 Jag that Enzo Ferrari called “the most beautiful car ever made”; Atlanta Wraps shows how wrapping Corvettes and Lamborghinis can color a car fast. Caffeine and Exotics is featured again to show off the coolest wraps Atlanta can supply.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - Panoz Racing & Chasing Chevys
programme.desc: Twenty-five years of hand building record-setting race cars is no easy task. But don’t tell that to Don Panoz who takes on Porsches and Ferraris with his laid back personality and a full-production facility that makes improvised versions of Americas V-8’s; Caffeine & Octane gets an exclusive look at an elusive man’s life long pursuit of everything Chevrolet.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - Retrofitting a Psycho Mercury
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane goes old school with Psycho Deville singer and pin striper Walt Richards. Richards has less than a week to hand paint his signature flames on a way cool ’50 Mercury. An introduction to Retrofit Lighting’s trickle down technology - from cars to motorcycles - that will revolutionize how bikes will see and be seen.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - Beetles, Bugs, and Buses, Oh My!
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation is tested when over 100 VW’s, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattled into an event. The annual VW Invasion has swarmed C&O, bringing with it Bugs, Beetles, Buses and more by a very dedicated VW fan base.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - Big Tigger v. Monster Muscle
programme.desc: Season 1 finishes on a high note when rapper, radio, and ATL TV personality Darian “Big Tigger” Morgan invites Caffeine & Octane into his home. Cameras look past his collection of 500 Michael Jordan shoes to focus their lenses on a one-off motorcycle the 6 – time NBA Champion gave to Tigger as a gift; A second to none, muscle car collection by one of the founders of Monster Energy gets toured by one of our hosts.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Vintage Testarossas and Quatra Valve Ferraris don’t just show up on a dealer’s floor, they’re hunted! Adam Merlin, exotic car expert, has spent a lifetime searching for the cars that defined his youth, but nothing is assumed or given in his high stakes game of Risk; A muscle car fiend shows off his private collection to host Skip Smith.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - Andrew Jones' Super Jeep
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. Former Atlanta Brave, World Series star, and 10-Time Gold Glove winner Andruw Jones acknowledged the stardom and showed up to show off his 6 wheeled Super Jeep. The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country’s greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt ‘59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage
programme.sub-title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Family Truckster Restoration Part 3
programme.desc: Nick Rutter provides valuable tips and techniques for how super clean automotive upholstery, as well as the proper chemicals and detailing tools for deep cleaning vinyl and rubber surfaces.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage
programme.sub-title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Family Truckster Restoration Part 4
programme.desc: Nick Rutter provides valuable tips and techniques for how to polish automotive glass as well as water spot removal and selecting the right polisher for the detailing job.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.sub-title: Two Guys Garage - Federated Project Truck
programme.desc: The guys have Federated’s 1990 454SS Project Truck in house and they’re doing a ton of work to it. From brakes and shocks to chassis work, this truck needs some love.

programme.desc: Headlining GLORY 110 is a contest for the vacant GLORY featherweight world championship as Portuguese sensation Miguel Trindade takes on Belgian ‘Bad Boy’ Deniz Demirkapu.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: In the quarter finals, Belgian Moroccan Anis Bouzid (48-4, 37 KO) takes on kickboxing legend Errol Zimmerman (112-20-1, 45 KO), Serbian sensation Milos Cvjeticanin (17-5, 10 KO) meets number one French heavyweight Sofian Laidouni (42-5-1, 20 KO), monstrous Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (29-4-1, 16 KO) clashes with ‘The Soldier’ Nidal Bchiri (20-5-1, 5 KO), and ‘The Black Ghost’ Mory Kromah (35-3-1, 21 KO) collides with outspoken rival Michael ‘Timebomb’ Boapeah (23-5-1, 29 KO). Only one fighter can come out on top and walk away as the new ‘King of Kickboxing’. Elsewhere, the always exciting Bahram Rajabzadeh (72-6, 64 KO) goes up against ‘The Gladiator’ Cristian Ristea (44-27, 13 KO), Hamicha (42-2, 31 KO) puts his undefeated GLORY record on the line against late replacement Brice Kombou (20-6, 5 KO), and featherweights Andre Santos (23-2, 10 KO) and Deniz Demirkapu (15-5, 10 KO) will kick-off the main card.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Franco es policía y demanda a su ex Johana porque ella finge el secuestro de sus hijos para huir de sus maltratos. Exagente de ICE deporta a su papá, ahora quiere hacer lo mismo con su hermano.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Arlet pide el divorcio de Víctor, él tiene otras mujeres a quienes obliga a comportarse como si fuesen perras. Sofía vive en una tribu de madres solteras, el padre de su hijo exige la custodia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La bailarina exótica; Los viejos se rebelan
programme.desc: A Talía la botan de la casa por enseñar a la hija de Jeny a bailar y a cobrar por hacerlo. Annette demanda a Angélica, dueña del hogar de ancianos donde su madre se enamoró de otra mujer.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El hijo del coronel; Protector depredador
programme.desc: Cleris le exige a Stephanie que le devuelva a su hijo, lo dejó con ella para alejarlo de su padre, un militar cubano. Amanda demanda a su madre por dejarla con su padrastro, él abusó de ella.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El disparo oscuro; Amor a palo
programme.desc: Luego de dos meses en coma, tras una pelea doméstica, ya no tiene a sus hijos y ahora los quiere de vuelta. El esposo los descubre en la cama y, en medio de la pelea, el amante lo mata y huye.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Quiero ser de ella; La niña detective
programme.desc: Yuleika cree en la tradición latina de que los golpes enseñan y lo aplica con su hija de 20 años, incluso delante de su nieto. Isabela denuncia a su papá con la policía y lo deportan.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Gustavo es guardaespaldas y fue baleado durante el secuestro de la familia que protege. Además, Jorge descubre a Yanelis con el mecánico, ambos estaban en el garaje, desmayados y desnudos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La muerte, una opción; Señora de las cinco décadas
programme.desc: Olga ha dedicado toda su vida al cuidado de su hija, quien nació con problemas neuronales. Por otro lado, Rosa se enamora de un chico mucho más joven que ella y decide divorciarse.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Acusan a David de violar a Aidé, pero ella asegura que él de quien abusó fue de su hermana. Le entrega los ahorros a su marido para comprar un camión, pero él lo invierte en su otra familia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Detrás de la niña; Suministro al diablo
programme.desc: Fernando no quiere más hijos, pero su esposa se aprovecha de él mientras duerme para tener sexo. Lázaro vandaliza la empresa de Orlando porque envía suministros a la dictadura de Daniel Ortega.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Fui violado, me too; Prostitución legal
programme.desc: Lo protege durante el día, pero de noche lo viola y le dice que él es gay. Rafael descubre que su esposa Doris tiene en la casa un negocio de prostitución con muñecas inflables.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Tortuga en la vagina; Me enseñaste a odiarte
programme.desc: Fue detenida por tráfico animal, ella culpa a Roberto por la tortuga que lleva en la vagina. Exige emanciparse de su padre por su comportamiento violento, él alega que la agresiva era la madre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su esposo muere porque la ambulancia no llegó a tiempo al hospital, ella demanda al chofer. Pablo y Ernesto tienen una relación de amor, odio, deseo y celos que no los deja vivir en armonía.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Maruchka demanda a su amiga Lily por publicar un video de ella donde se muestra su sobrepeso. Julio y Martina están en desacuerdo sobre el medicamento que le recetó el pediatra a su hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Terror a la migra; Venta de información
programme.desc: El hijo de Lilian muere a consecuencia de un ataque de pánico provocado por una broma que hicieron en su colegio. Además, David, quien fue víctima de hackers, contrata a Samuel como modelo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Demasiado con tres y se sumó uno; Babysitter chapeadora
programme.desc: Marie y Neysi reciben clases de baile, las graban y suben los videos a la web para ser vistas por presos. Elisa pierde a un cliente porque Garnet la denunció como secuestradora de su hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Pedro fue golpeado por vándalos y en la cirugía dañaron su cerebro, ahora no controla sus instintos sexuales. Alexandra descubre que su inquilina tiene un negocio clandestino de placer.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Antonio un cazatalentos de jugadores de béisbol, termina involucrado en un problema de drogas. Luis le dijo un piropo fuera de tono a Isabel, y ella reacciona mal al sentirse acosada.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Wilmer pide anular el testamento de su papá porque deja como heredera a la niña de Sandra, quien lo engañó. Melissa busca recuperar a su hijo, quien fue adoptado por Raúl y su esposa.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Mujer que no existe; La pandora
programme.desc: A Mateo, creador de un personaje anónimo de magazine, lo presionan para que dé la cara. Heidy decidió viajar por el mundo, pero sus vacaciones las pagan los hombres que encuentra en el camino.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El chupón estafador; Mascota de moda
programme.desc: René pide el divorcio de Andrea porque ella mintió al decir que tenía cáncer para esconder un chupón de su amante. Cristal tiene una cerdita de mascota, su esposo dice que los puercos se comen.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: José Ángel le dispara al perro de su vecina, ella pide compensación, él alega que fue en defensa propia. Venda un ovario y años después se entera de que en la cirugía le extirparon el útero.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Al salir en libertad, Diana le pide a Ceci que le dé la propiedad que tienen en común porque cumplió prisión por su culpa. Fidel le promete a Lorena que en tres meses triplicaría la inversión.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sofía le exige a su esposo Carlos, un venezolano que quiere regresar a su patria, que pida asilo político en los Estados Unidos, de lo contrario pide el divorcio y la custodia total de su hijo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Seguros médicos vs. religión; Madre abandonó a los tres años
programme.desc: Alejandra demanda a su jefe por suprimir la cobertura de anticonceptivos de su seguro médico. El padre de Susana desaparece, ella exige su emancipación y una orden de desalojo para su madre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Oxitocina para infieles; Mundial: México vs. Brasil
programme.desc: Orlando demanda a su esposa, pide el divorcio y 50 mil dólares, ella lo medicó para someterlo. Arturo es mexicano y Suzzy es brasileña, todo iba bien, pero el fútbol los convirtió en rivales.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Accidente por sexomnia; Jardinero gay quiere hijastra
programme.desc: América le practica sexo oral a Alejandro en la carretera y provoca un accidente, ella está enferma. Mariana quiere que la madre biológica de su hijastra se lleve a la niña, se siente incómoda.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Hijo jugador, madre secuestrada; Quién trajo el herpes
programme.desc: Carmen es violada y queda embarazada, además tiene cáncer, su esposo quiere que aborte. Santiago acusa a su esposa de contagiarlo con herpes, pero ella nunca lo engañó y pide una explicación.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Mordida de perro; Huyendo a mi condición
programme.desc: El perro de Ilarisa muerde a Sandy en la cara. Pensó que la dueña del animal era inocente; estaba equivocada. Abandonó a su esposo y a su hijo para vivir como lesbiana, pero quiere la herencia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Mi esposa me embarazó; Menor embarazada en Internet
programme.desc: Mariana es lesbiana, su mujer le transfiere la semilla de su amante y la embaraza, quiere manutención. Ivette exige que su hija regrese a casa, le permitió emanciparse, pero ella no le cumplió.

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: In Illinois, a 16-year-old boy goes to speak with a contractor about a summer job. He tells his mother it'll only take a minute, but no one ever sees him again. Working with psychics Carol Broman and Dorothy Allison, police identify the kidnapper and discover he's killed many others. When two women are abducted and found stabbed to death outside Morristown, NJ, police believe they have a serial killer on their hands. Local psychic Nancy Orlen Weber works with detectives to try and catch him before he finds his next victim.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society investigate a suspected haunting in an old multi-use church. However, the investigation takes an unexpected emotional turn as they connect with a surprising spirit. What begins as a typical haunting becomes deeply personal, and the team moves from assumption to affirmation—all caught on camera.

programme.title: Paranormal Contact
programme.desc: Jeff DeEll, Adam Myles, and Kelly Klassen explore haunted locations along Canada’s east coast, seeking contact with the dead and uncovering the hidden stories that linger in the shadows. Guided by intuition, research, and firsthand encounters, they venture deep into the unknown to give a voice to the spirits still waiting to be heard.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Agustina asesina a su hermana Rebeca para salvar a Irene y a su bebé. Luego los doctores revelan que ella sufría un trastorno de doble personalidad y que creía fervientemente que ella era en realidad su hermana muerta. Tony y Maribel terminan juntos, por comprar una nueva casa para irse a vivir juntos y formar una nueva familia. También Anzola termina casándose con Trinidad en una fiesta de casamiento a la cual toda la familia estuvo invitada. Felipe logra poner tras las rejas a Alejandra y a Rodrigo por los crímenes que cometieron. Antes de llevarlos a la prisión, deja a ella hacer su último descargo con Rodrigo en el que le confiesa que nunca lo perdonará por arruinarle la vida.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Nancy se retira furiosa de la junta de condominio, Pedro logra que Carlos Enrique se quede hablando con Lázara en lugar de ir detrás de su mujer. Patricia deja de estudiar y se va de la casa, harta de las burlas de Carlitos. Al pasar por delante de Pedrote este la intercepta para flirtear con ella y darle celos a Purita. Nancy los ve juntos y se indigna más aún. Cristóbal reserva el salón del condominio para casarse con Ana, ante los ojos de Guillermo. Nancy se queja con Carlitos de lo sucedido en la junta con su padre, pero a Carlitos sólo le interesa enterarse de que Purita quedó sola. Pedro logra que Cristóbal ponga de padrino de bodas al mismísimo Guillermo, generando incomodidad entre él y Ana.

programme.title: Episodio 108 (2026)
programme.desc: Armando bota definitivamente a Finita de su oficina y de su vida. Por más que ella quiso explicarle | el no aceptó ninguna explicación y la sacó. Briggite anda perdida como siempre. No sabe lo que está haciendo caminando por un pasillo del centro comercial. Pero se encuentra con Yubiri y aprovecha para decirle que regrese a la agencia. Fabián sigue con el ratón. Llega Palma el Productor para darle una gran noticia a Wilker y es que consiguió una presentación en Sábado Sensacional.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Agustín confronta a Gabriel en la calle para dejarle claro que no se vuelva a meter con su mujer. programme.title: Blitzed: The 80s Blitz Kids Story (2023)
programme.desc: Boy George was the coat check girl (admittedly stealing money from the purses) .... Bowie, synth beats, and a new freedom of sexual identity were in the air. The Blitz Club spell was cast and a hotbed of talent emerged: Ultravox, Spandau Ballet, Culture Club, Sade, and practically everyone else you've ever heard from the era.

programme.title: MOD SUN Interview: Walk With Me | SPIN Cover Story
programme.desc: No doubt MOD’s lived many lives since Happy To Be Here was first published in 2015, stating that he feels fortunate to have accomplished so much of what he’d set out to do. His main goal is to keep evolving.

programme.title: Gil Scott-Heron - Black Wax (2023)
programme.desc: BLACK WAX is a musical-political entertainment film produced and directed by Robert Mugge. It centers on the late African American poet-singer-songwriter Gil Scott-Heron - the man Melody Maker called the most dangerous musician alive and many dubbed the forefather of rap music - and his Midnight Band.

programme.title: SPIN COVER STORY yungblud: "walk with me"
programme.desc: If Yungblud led a cult, many would join - even those who fancy themselves hard to persuade. He has an orbit, an aura, an affability that is borderline intoxicating. You can experience it for yourself during our walk with Yungblud through the Sunset Strip, from the Viper Room to the Rainbow Bar and Grill – watch Yungblud share some incredible stories and a Dr Pepper

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders (2023)
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: From Amadeus the worlds first rockstar to The Beatles and Elvis, Hollywood has always remembered "When Rock Was Young"

programme.title: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies (2023)
programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: From Amadeus the worlds first rockstar to The Beatles and Elvis, Hollywood has always remembered "When Rock Was Young"

programme.title: Until The Light Takes Us (2023)
programme.desc: Until The Light Takes Us tells the story of black metal. Part music scene and part cultural uprising, black metal rose to worldwide notoriety in the mid-nineties when a rash of suicides, murders, and church burnings accompanied the explosive artistic growth and output of a music scene that would forever redefine what heavy metal is and what it stands for.

programme.title: Great Destinations Europe
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

programme.title: Sarah Graham’s Food Safari
programme.sub-title: Victoria Falls Safari Lodge - Victoria Falls, Zimbabwe
programme.desc: Sarah Graham meets with the head chef of the restaurant at Victoria Falls Safari Lodge and learns the recipe for their famous warthog steaks; Sarah prepares a brie baked in phyllo pastry and pear tarte tatin with white chocolate and rosemary drizzle.

programme.title: Wine, Dine and Stein
programme.sub-title: Wine, Dine and Stein: Groot Phesantekraal
programme.desc: Chef Jack Stein travels with his family to find the ultimate pairings with wine and food.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.sub-title: Amazonas - Shadows of the Rubber Boom
programme.desc: With the Chief’s blessing—and a gesture of goodwill in the form of Canadian maple syrup—Jeff is invited to spend a day immersed in the region’s haunting past. Guided by the Chief, he visits rubber trees still standing as silent witnesses to the atrocities of the 1920s Amazon rubber boom, where the Chief’s own grandparents were slaughtered. The journey leads to the ruins of the Arana Brothers’ former headquarters, a chilling site of colonial exploitation, brutality, and genocide. In this moving episode, history, memory, and reconciliation converge deep in the jungle.

programme.title: American Travelers
programme.desc: Dave & Kari visit Old Town Sacramento, located near their home town of Auburn.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Arriving at the stunning resort of LUX* Belle Mare, Brent is amazed by their stylish, contemporary spin on luxury hospitality. Surrounded by tropical gardens and pristine white beaches, this is what everyone imagines Mauritius to be and more. He meets up with Chef Nicolas where they cook up a seafood specialty which they then enjoy under the sun on the beach. With a reef nearby, Brent rents a glass bottomed kayak and paddles out to check out the sea life. Then hopping on a bicycle, he rides to a nearby market to get the ingredients he needs for his take on a Chef Nicolas's dish, Mauritian lobster rolls, which he prepares under shady palms.

programme.desc: On March 2, 2012, 19-year-old Jacob “Jake” Limberios was fatally shot in the head in the presence of three friends. The coroner ruled his death a suicide -- but Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say it doesn’t add up. They claim there was no investigation into Jake’s death, no evidence collected and no autopsy performed before Jake's death was ruled a suicide -- and they refuse to believe their son would take his own life. Jake’s family say a lot of questions remain unanswered, including: Who fired the shot? Two witnesses, Brittany and Will, adamantly maintain that Jake accidentally shot himself, but Mike and Shannon say their son knew how to handle guns safely and that the evidence doesn’t support that conclusion. Mike takes Dr. Phil cameras to the scene of the shooting to demonstrate why he believes that Jake was shot by someone else in the room. And, Brittany and Will face Mike and Shannon on Dr. Phil’s stage in an attempt to clear the cloud of suspicion that they say still follows them as a result of Mike and Shannon’s allegations. When offered a chance to take a polygraph test, will they accept? Don’t miss this compelling two-part mystery.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The family of 19-year-old Jake Limberios continues to search for answers surrounding his death in March 2012. Who fired the gunshot that ended his life? Brittany and Will, who witnessed the shooting, say Jake, a gun enthusiast, accidentally shot himself in the head. Although the coroner ruled his death a suicide, Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say their son, a young father, never would’ve taken his own life. Left with so many unanswered questions, Jake’s parents had his body exhumed and autopsied by renowned forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht, who concluded that Jake’s cause of death wasn’t suicide. Dr. Phil speaks with Dr. Wecht via satellite -- hear why he says Jake couldn’t have shot himself. Plus, Brittany and Will say they sympathize with Jake’s parents but are tired of being under suspicion and agree to take polygraph tests to prove they’re not hiding any details about Jake’s death. What will the results reveal? And, Mike and Shannon say their marriage has grown strained since their son’s death -- can they learn to come together and find peace after such a painful loss?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Some believe self-censorship is a big problem today, particularly in light of the idea that someone can be "canceled" for their words -- blocked from having a prominent public platform or career for sharing their opinion. Dr. Phil interviews Nate, a former Idaho police officer, who claims he was fired after making a TikTok video about NBA superstar LeBron James that went viral and has been viewed over 4 million times. Nate explains how the fall-out from the video affected him and his family, too. Dr. Phil also speaks with conservative political commentator Tomi Lahren, who says she recently had to be protected by state police from student protestors at the University of New Mexico. Greg Lukianoff, president of the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression, says he believes Americans have lost the ability to discuss their differences rationally. And, Dr. Shaun Harper, founder and Executive Director of the USC Race and Equity Center, says he is firmly against hate speech and feels people need to be more mindful about the effects of their words.

programme.desc: The “self-censorship” debate continues. Meet Alejandro, a student who claims administrators at his community college violated his free speech rights. He says when he and members of the club Young Americans for Freedom posted flyers on campus, they were censored. Then, which public figures are fighting back against cancel culture? And, Dr. Phil takes a closer look at a list of terms that are now allegedly off limits. What words are on that list? Tune in to find out.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Investigation into home food sensitivity tests – are they legit or a waste of a time and money? Shocking story of mom’s debilitating stimulant addiction! Class action lawsuit over vitamin shots? The craziest things dogs have eaten in “My Dog Ate What?”

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: My Breast Implants Made Me Sick
programme.desc: In an exclusive interview, a former Playboy Playmate claims her implants made her sick and says she’s not the only one! Derek Hough reveals how he stays fit and gives the inside scoop on his new show! Find out why some parents are potty training their kids … in public! A young man with a family history of early-onset Alzheimer’s turns to The Doctors! What will be revealed? Get the warning signs you need to know! Plus, a hoarder finally finds freedom … how did she do it?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Plagued by rumors of crack use, meth use, cancer and his HIV status, pop star Aaron Carter comes to The Doctors in a world exclusive to find out what’s really going. Can Aaron on be saved from The wreckage of superstardom? In Part 2 of our Aaron Carter exclusive, The Doctors is tasked with delivering the news to Aaron about his blood tests for HIV and meth use.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Embarrassing, Gross, and Wild Special brings you some of The Doctors’ most unforgettable moments! See “The Great Pop-Off”! Relive Dr. Pimple Popper’s biggest and best pops! Marvel at the courage of guests who shared Their most embarrassing problems to raise awareness! From the huge, painful keloids that isolated a school teacher to The severe birthmarks that tormented a young woman, These guests stepped out of the shadows for help. Don’t miss one man’s 315-pound transformation! Laugh and learn as Dr. Ordon and NBA star Jon Salley undergo prostate exams backstage! Score a simple fix for dry, chalky elbows.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors count down the top C words that cause consternation. And, new treatments for corns, calluses and constipation!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: THE DOCTORS tests an app that promises to measure just how ugly you are and the results aren’t pretty! Find out why a hospital billed a couple for holding their newborn! In a THE DOCTORS exclusive, Olivia Newton-John’s daughter, Chloe Lattanzi, reveals the truth behind the plastic surgery rumors! Then, baseball legend Darryl Strawberry discusses his battle with addiction and his attempt to reach out to NBA star Lamar Odom! Plus, the hidden dangers of Halloween make-up

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Considering plastic surgery of any kind? Don't miss Krissy's story and Dr. Ordon's essential do's and don'ts to keep you safe. Watch several controversial potty training techniques in action and see if any of them are right for your child.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Ways To Take Charge Of Your Health
programme.desc: Is a simple seasoning the culprit for expanding waistlines? Most Americans consume two to three times the amount of salt necessary per day. The Nutrition Twins, registered dieticians, believe excess salt is largely to blame for America’s obesity epidemic. Learn their secret to staying skinny and try the diet designed to kick the salt habit for good! THE DOCTORS joins forces with Iams pet food to support Iams’ Home 4 the Holidays pet adoption program. Learn the health benefits of pets, for both humans and animals alike! A controversial court ruling in a worker’s compensation case may change the way employers hire. Will your weight jeopardize your job prospects? Plastic surgeon Dr. Drew Ordon demonstrates the latest wrinkle-relaxer on 35-year-old Jennifer. See the amazing after results! If you’re trying to lose weight, studies have shown that when you eat may be more important than what you eat. Snacking at the wrong time can increase your weight gain by 50 percent! Find out when to nibble and when to just say no. Pediatrician Dr. Jim Sears uncovers hidden choking dangers for toddlers and demonstrates what to do if your child’s airway is obstructed.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: HOLIDAY: During the holidays, the average American consumes 619 extra calories daily! Fitness guru Jillian Michaels joins "The Doctors" to offer tips to keep your family’s figures slim and svelte while celebrating the season!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Staying healthy can sometimes feel like a challenge too large to overcome. Talk-show host Montel Williams joins THE DOCTORS to help you take charge of your health! Previously on THE DOCTORS, Montel helped motivate Alex, who suffers from dystonia. See how she is doing now and learn about a procedure that may help Alex overcome the disorder! Do your family dinners lack the proper nutrition? Montel makes a house call and provides one family with an action plan for healthier eating. The outbreak of the swine flu caused a nationwide scare. Now, the vaccine for the strain of flu is cause for concern. Former acting U.S. Surgeon General, Steven J, Galson, answers your H1N1 vaccine questions.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Ask Our Docs: Where, When and Why
programme.desc: From when your child should start talking to why hormones affect your mood, The Doctors tackles your biggest who, what, where, when and why questions. And, get the most effective home remedies from around the globe.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors is giving prostate exams throughout the show and Dr. Ordon and former NBA star John Salley are taking one for the team! In an exclusive interview, The parents of a little boy whose skin blisters when you touch him share what daily life is like. See The surprise that leaves him speechless! Young Hollywood stars and artists tackle The global water crisis! Find out how you can help! Then, see the marriage proposal that involved a dramatic set up and … projectile vomiting?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Comedienne Niecy Nash goes on assignment to uncover mystifying body quirks and what you can do about them. And, a new, minimally invasive procedure promises to put an end to heavy periods. Plus, common sex mistakes men make.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Fix It or Live With It?
programme.desc: Embarrassing conditions, annoying problem areas, unsightly body parts … everyone has at least one or two. But you don’t have to be stuck with them! Get solutions for painful heartburn, frequent urination, stuttering and more.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Do you get body tremors? Does your butt jiggle? Do you tremble when you get a high fever? Learn why your body shakes, shimmies and shivers! And, shake your way to a better physique.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Backaches, allergies and toothaches are among the most common recurring health problems. Find out how to keep your chronic medical issues from coming back, and learn to keep body odor and bad breath at bay.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: From backaches, to headaches to earaches, learn simple solutions to relieve nagging aches and pains. And, learn a unique and effective way to treat colicky babies.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: HOLIDAY: A month into the new year, and if you’ve gotten off track with your resolutions, don’t worry. Editor-in-chief of Prevention, Liz Vaccariello, joins The Doctors with simple ways to revitalize your will power.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Are you constantly surfing the net trying to self-diagnose a mysterious pain? The Doctors reveal what symptoms are safe to ignore and when you need to pay closer attention. Learn the safe and scary causes of numbness, heart palpitations, easy bruising and more

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Witness the most dramatic makeovers ever seen on television; see miraculous transformations and lives changed forever. Dr. Bill Dorfman performs a Gummy Makeover. And, the latest surgical procedure that promises to lengthen limbs.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Decipher the clues and warning signs your body is giving you. Witness a life-saving surgery that a mother and daughter underwent together! Plus, learn what kind of bruises can indicate a serious medical condition.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: An alarming number of children are developing food allergies. Is your child one of them? Learn how to recognize symptoms and what treatments can keep your child safe. Is the fastest way to lose weight … eating more cookies? See if the controversial Cookie Diet is right for you! Find out what every woman needs to know about menopause, including the latest treatments to make the transition easier than ever! Do organs have memories? Learn about the fascinating research conducted on organ transplants and cellular memory.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Bizarre in The E.R. - strange but true emergency room stories you won’t believe! Plus, “The Doctors Court” discusses how an ex-inmate is suing a jail for $5 million after he claims They ignored his 91-hour surprise erection! And, a brand new dad was arrested for selling heroin in the hospital’s maternity ward! Then, should high school students be segregated at lunchtime by their GPAs? And, don’t look now ladies, but pimple-popping nails are in vogue! Would you try them?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: My Nose Was Destroying My Life
programme.desc: A woman left deformed and devastated by a medical condition gets a new nose and a new lease on life! The Doctors debates a new ADHD medication for kids that tastes like candy! Can Botox be addictive? Find out! Plus, go inside the mind of a serial killer with a woman who was obsessed with one for years! The Doctors breaks down how many cups of coffee to drink to reduce your risk of Alzheimer’s. Is hitting the gym on the weekend enough to make a difference? Hear what science has to say!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The holidays are just around the corner! Get delicious recipes to cut fat and calories from traditional Thanksgiving fare. And, three tips to prevent overeating! Plus, burn off extra pounds fast with the No Excuses workout.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Fix your biggest pains with food! Learn how what you eat can help heal heartburn, soothe toothaches, ease PMS symptoms and more. Plus, snacks that can make migraines and earaches worse. And, how a dill pickle could ease arthritis.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Crackling fires, hot cocoa and snowy slopes are all part of winter’s charm. But cold weather can also be hazardous to our health. Learn how to stay healthy and avoid winter mishaps. Pediatrician Dr. Jim Sears fields questions from youngsters that include whether it’s safe to eat snow, why noses turn red in the cold and what to do if your tongue sticks to a frozen pole! And, Dr. Jim shares his top ten family winter safety tips. Are food cravings seasonal? When it’s cold outside, you may have the urge to eat more carbohydrates, but find out what your body is really telling you! And, plastic surgeon Dr. Drew Ordon shares at-home remedies to soothe dry, chapped skin and conditioning secrets to tame your mane.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors go Live in the OR to witness a knee replacement surgery! Woman finds out if she’s been catfished! Viral TikTok star talks about her life living with alopecia! Missouri woman fights to keep pet monkeys she claims helps her with PTSD!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Ask Our Docs: Hot and Cold Edition
programme.desc: The Doctors reveals the best hot and cold remedies for ailments. And, surprising ways the weather can sabotage your health. From winter storm warnings to heat waves, learn how to keep your family safe.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Exclusive: A woman famous for her 70-inch booty visits The Doctors! Is she in for a shocking diagnosis? Then, are you upping your family’s fire risk without even knowing it? We reveal three dangerous household items! Plus, a woman desperate to walk again turns to The Doctors for help!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Don't Let It Happen to You
programme.desc: The Doctors are joined by home improvement guru and safety expert, Eric Stromer, to share important tips about home, flood and fire safety. Learn what to do if you find yourself in a dangerous situation. And, kitchen safety rules to live by.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: One of the biggest thrills of parenting is learning that your child has a big heart. But one of the biggest terrors is learning your child has a defective heart. Special guest Dr. Gregory Fontana is one of the leading pediatric heart surgeons in the country.

programme.title: Metroland (1998)
programme.desc: After ten years absence Toni, Chris's best friend, suddenly reappears in London to bring chaos and doubt into Chris's calm, tranquil, slightly boring, predictable life. Chris starts to remember his carefree youth as a photographer in Paris when he lived with and enjoyed a torrid affair with Annick. It was also in Paris that he first met and fell in love with Marion. The temptations and pressure exerted on Chris by Toni to return to their former carefree life of sex, drugs and rock'n'roll soon starts to have an impact on Chris's marriage. He starts to question his values, his lifestyle choices and his relationship with Marion and even suspects her of starting an affair with Toni whom she dislikes! Eventually circumstances come to a head and Chris is forced to decide whether to follow Toni back to the hedonistic, irresponsible life of his youth or face the harsh realities of the present and stay with Marion.

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E07 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E08 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]

Undeterred, Shishigami continues his killing, and announces he will kill 1000 tomorrow, devastating Inuyashiki.
